title: Clarification Notice No. 1 to ITT-2027-LEGAL-03
paragraphs: This clarification notice forms part of ITT-2027-LEGAL-03 (Meridian Infrastructure Group Legal Services Panel 2027). It responds to clarification questions received before 12 January 2027. All other requirements remain unchanged.
Requirement 7.1 is amended to read: State your standard response times for acknowledging and substantively responding to instructions, including out-of-hours arrangements.
Requirement 9.1 is amended to read: State the level of professional indemnity insurance cover held, the insurer's rating and the policy renewal date.
New requirement 10.6: Describe the security review applied to any artificial intelligence tools used on client matters.
New requirement 11.6: State the firm's most recently reported gender pay gap.
The submission deadline in requirement 2.1 is unchanged.
